test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people R, S, T, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people are sitting between S and G when counted from the right of S. Only two people are sitting between E and T when counted from the left of E. R is sitting second to the right of G. T is not an immediate neighbour of R. D is not an immediate neighbour of G. Who is sitting to the immediate left and to the immediate right of F, respectively?
solution:
Given:

Seven people R, S, T, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Only two people are sitting between S and G when counted from the right of S.

R is sitting second to the right of G.

Only two people are sitting between E and T when counted from the left of E.

 T is not an immediate neighbour of R. D is not an immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e6bbcaa8643d5010abe89287e50a94a6d0568a719c9a7b47076ac149bfd7e15.png] 

Thus, T and G sit immediate left and to the immediate right of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
